    TAP_AND_NAME_COMPARISON = T.let(
      proc do |a, b|
        if a.include?("/") && b.exclude?("/")
          1
        elsif a.exclude?("/") && b.include?("/")
          -1
        else
          a <=> b
        end
      end.freeze,
      T.proc.params(a: String, b: String).returns(Integer),
